title: Trace release acceptance shell and exit-code propagation

findings.summary: The only CLI process spawn asserts exit 1 on a complete NO-GO. parseAcceptanceArgs extra/duplicate flags throw at function level (lines 299-300) and never observe process.exitCode 2, usage stderr, empty stdout, or absent --out. Missing-input and publication-failure process rows are absent.
findings.affected_invariant: Documented exit 2 for invalid arguments or failure to retain output (docs/release-acceptance.md:38-40).
findings.smallest_correction: P004: spawn go-no-go.ts for the missing-input matrix in /work/out/command-to-exit-truth-table.json. Do not add duplicate evaluateRelease empty-index tests (already at go-no-go.test.ts:138-156,294).

findings.summary: Documented command is bun run release:acceptance. The process test invokes the file path directly and requires empty stderr. bun run prefixes `$ bun scripts/go-no-go.ts …` and, when Bun fails to start the script, reports `error: script "release:acceptance" exited with code 1`.
findings.affected_invariant: Callers of the documented package script must not treat wrapper or runtime exit 1 as a produced NO-GO.
findings.smallest_correction: P011: assert argument forwarding and distinguish runner_blocked from script 0/1/2. P004: optional package-script spawn alongside the direct script.

findings.location: scripts/go-no-go.ts static import of ./qualification → packages/core/src/serving/packet-tokenizer.ts; packages/core/package.json js-tiktoken@1.0.21
findings.summary: On this read-only archive, bun without a writable transpiler cache exits 1 with ReadOnlyFileSystem. bun --no-install exits 1 with missing js-tiktoken/lite before parseAcceptanceArgs. Missing CLI args still require a successful module load.
findings.affected_invariant: Shell exit 1 is overloaded: produced NO-GO versus Bun cannot run the checker.
findings.smallest_correction: P011 harness must classify runner_blocked separately. Operators need bun@1.3.14, installed workspace deps, and a writable transpiler cache if the tree is read-only.

findings.summary: process.exitCode 0 is implemented for decision GO. gates() hardcodes required UNVERIFIABLE/NOT_IMPLEMENTED rows, so accepted cannot be true. Documented; tests already assert NO-GO. Not a parser bug.
findings.smallest_correction: Do not invent a GO fixture. Leave exit 0 mapping as specified until producers exist (outside this packet).
